title: 蒸馏（下）
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/16_Distillation II.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/16_Distillation II/src.py

points.K17: 慢慢抽真空，停沸再加热
points.K19: 结束：撤热、关真空、冷却、放气

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一套带冷阱和真空管的蒸馏装置旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a vacuum distillation setup with a cold trap in a mesh guard, thick red vacuum tubing and a round-bottom flask in a heating mantle, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学减压蒸馏。

shots.scene: 温度计图标和向下的压力箭头
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon beside a downward pressure arrow, the boiling mark sliding lower. No people.
shots.narration: 压力降下来，沸点也跟着降。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着一瓶高沸点的液体，旁边温度计读数很高
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a flask of thick high-boiling liquid next to a thermometer showing a very high reading.
shots.narration: 阿杰要蒸一个高沸点的产物。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里的液体开始变黑冒烟
shots.prompt_en: The liquid in the flask darkens and gives off a little smoke under strong heat. No people.
shots.narration: 常压硬加热，产物先分解了。

shots.scene: 小研指着真空管和冷阱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the vacuum tubing and the cold trap.
shots.narration: 小研说：减压蒸，低温就能蒸出来。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开上一课的空白笔记
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank notebook showing a simple distillation sketch.
shots.narration: 先学会简单蒸馏和分馏，再学这课。

shots.scene: 温度条上一百五十度以下高亮
shots.prompt_en: A temperature bar highlighted below a middle mark. No people.
shots.narration: 简单蒸馏，适合一百五十度以下的液体。

shots.scene: 温度条一百五十度以上部分标红，分子图标断裂
shots.prompt_en: The upper part of the temperature bar is shaded red and a molecule icon above it breaks apart. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点更高的，常压加热容易分解。

shots.scene: 真空泵图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum pump icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这时就要减压蒸馏。

shots.scene: 液体蒸气压箭头与外压箭头对顶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a liquid surface with an upward vapor pressure arrow meeting a downward outside pressure arrow of equal size. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气压等于外压时，液体沸腾。

shots.scene: 外压箭头变小，沸腾提前出现
shots.prompt_en: The outside pressure arrow shrinks and bubbles appear at a lower thermometer mark. No people.
shots.narration: 外压降低，在较低温度就能沸腾。

shots.scene: 烧瓶上加一个双颈的克氏蒸馏头
shots.prompt_en: A two-necked bent adapter is fitted between the round-bottom flask and the distilling head, highlighted in yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 烧瓶和蒸馏头之间，加一个克氏蒸馏头。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里液体剧烈冒泡，被弯管挡住
shots.prompt_en: Liquid bumps violently in the flask and the splash is stopped by the bend of the adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 减压时液体爱暴沸，它能挡住冲料。

shots.scene: 两种多尾接液管并排
shots.prompt_en: Two multi-arm receiving adapters side by side, each with several small round flasks attached. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管末端，接多尾接液管。

shots.scene: 每个支口挂一个接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Close view of three small receiving flasks clipped onto the arms of the adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 每个支口挂一个接收瓶。

shots.scene: 真空下取下接收瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pulling a receiving flask off a running vacuum setup with air rushing in, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 真空下，不能像常压那样取瓶换瓶。

shots.scene: 手转动多尾接液管，下一个瓶子对准出口
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand rotates the multi-arm adapter so the next empty flask lines up under the drip.
shots.narration: 转一转接液管，就换到下一个瓶。

shots.scene: 厚壁真空管接在抽气口
shots.prompt_en: A thick-walled red vacuum hose is pushed onto the vacuum port of the adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 抽气口接厚壁真空管。

shots.scene: 薄壁管被抽瘪的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thin hose collapsing flat under vacuum, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 管壁太薄，一抽就瘪。

shots.scene: 真空管另一端接真空泵
shots.prompt_en: The other end of the hose connects to a rotary vacuum pump with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 另一端接真空泵或水泵。

shots.scene: 指针式真空表
shots.prompt_en: A dial vacuum gauge with a needle and a blank face. No people.
shots.narration: 真空源上还要接压力计，看压力。

shots.scene: 磨口被溶剂粘死的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a ground glass joint stuck tight with a frozen lock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 磨口不涂脂，溶剂渗进去会粘死。

shots.scene: 木棒在阳口上部涂一薄层脂
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses a wooden stick to spread a thin film of grease on the upper part of a male joint.
shots.narration: 阳口上部薄薄涂一层。

shots.scene: 套上阴口旋转，一圈变透明
shots.prompt_en: The female joint is twisted onto it until a clear ring of grease shows all around.
shots.narration: 套上转一转，整圈透明就好。

shots.scene: 脂涂太多、涂到下端的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thick glob of grease near the bottom tip of the joint dripping into the flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别涂太多，别涂到下端，会污染产物。

shots.scene: 所有活塞关闭，真空泵开启
shots.prompt_en: A glass manifold with all stopcocks turned closed while the vacuum pump switches on. No people.
shots.narration: 开蒸前先检漏：关好所有活塞，开真空。

shots.scene: 小研从靠近泵的一端开第一个活塞
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the stopcock nearest the pump first.
shots.narration: 从靠近真空源的那个，一个个打开。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标和嘶嘶声波
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon next to small hissing sound waves at a joint. No people.
shots.narration: 边开边听，有嘶嘶声就是漏气。

shots.scene: 关真空、放气、重新涂脂
shots.prompt_en: The vacuum is switched off, air is let in, and the leaking joint is re-greased.
shots.narration: 漏了就关真空、放气，重新涂脂再试。

shots.scene: 所有接口不漏，勾号
shots.prompt_en: The whole setup with every joint marked by a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 完全不漏，才能往下做。

shots.scene: 冷阱装在金属网罩里，接在泵前
shots.prompt_en: A glass cold trap inside a metal mesh guard placed between the setup and the pump. No people.
shots.narration: 确认不漏后，冷阱里加液氮。

shots.scene: 溶剂蒸气在冷阱里凝住，泵打勾
shots.prompt_en: Solvent vapor freezes on the cold trap walls and the pump beside it gets a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 把溶剂蒸气冻住，保护真空泵。

shots.scene: 液体倒进蒸馏瓶，放入搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: A liquid is poured into the distilling flask and a stir bar is dropped in. No people.
shots.narration: 液体转进烧瓶，放搅拌子。

shots.scene: 沸石孔里的空气被抽走的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a boiling stone whose pores are emptied of air by vacuum, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 沸石在真空下没用，孔里的气被抽光了。

shots.scene: 加热套升到烧瓶下，下面是搅拌器
shots.prompt_en: The heating mantle is raised under the flask with a magnetic stirrer below it. No people.
shots.narration: 加热套升上来，下面放搅拌器。

shots.scene: 调压器在零位，禁止加热标记
shots.prompt_en: A voltage controller dial at zero with a small pause icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这时先别加热。

shots.scene: 小研打开搅拌器，搅拌子旋转
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches on the stirrer and the stir bar spins in the flask.
shots.narration: 第一步：开搅拌。

shots.scene: 不搅拌时剧烈暴沸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unstirred flask bumping violently under vacuum, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不搅拌，暴沸的机会大大增加。

shots.section_title: 慢慢抽真空，停沸再加热
shots.scene: 手慢慢转动活塞，压力表指针缓缓下降
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns a stopcock slowly while a gauge needle sinks gradually.
shots.narration: 慢慢地、小心地抽真空。
overlay: 慢慢抽真空，停沸再加热

shots.section_title: 慢慢抽真空，停沸再加热
shots.scene: 未加热的烧瓶里冒泡
shots.prompt_en: The cold flask bubbles as dissolved air and low-boiling traces are pulled out. No people.
shots.narration: 没加热也冒泡，是空气和低沸物在跑。

shots.section_title: 慢慢抽真空，停沸再加热
shots.scene: 气泡平息后，调压器调高
shots.prompt_en: The bubbling settles, then the voltage controller is turned up. No people.
shots.narration: 冒泡停了，再开始加热。

shots.scene: 三条刻度线的列线图
shots.prompt_en: A nomograph with three vertical scale lines and no text. No people.
shots.narration: 减压下沸点多少？用列线图估算。

shots.scene: 中间线上标常压沸点，右线标压力
shots.prompt_en: A red dot marks a point on the middle line and another on the right line. No people.
shots.narration: 一条线找常压沸点，一条线标压力。

shots.scene: 直尺连两点，延长交到左线
shots.prompt_en: A ruler connects the two dots and extends to cross the left line at a third dot. No people.
shots.narration: 直尺一连，交点就是预计沸点。

shots.scene: 示例卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank example card with three rows of icons: thermometer, gauge, thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 比如三百二十度的液体，减压后约一百二十度。

shots.section_title: 结束：撤热、关真空、冷却、放气
shots.scene: 蒸完后降下加热套
shots.prompt_en: The heating mantle is lowered away from the flask after distillation. No people.
shots.narration: 结束：先移开热源。
overlay: 结束：撤热、关真空、冷却、放气

shots.section_title: 结束：撤热、关真空、冷却、放气
shots.scene: 关闭通向真空的活塞，等烧瓶冷却
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock to the vacuum is closed and a clock icon waits while the flask cools. No people.
shots.narration: 关真空，让它完全冷却。

shots.section_title: 结束：撤热、关真空、冷却、放气
shots.scene: 通入空气，停搅拌，取下接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Air is let in, the stirrer is switched off and the receiving flasks are removed. No people.
shots.narration: 再放气、停搅拌、取接收瓶。

shots.scene: 先常压装置蒸出低沸点液体
shots.prompt_en: A simple distillation setup collects a low-boiling fraction before the vacuum hose is connected. No people.
shots.narration: 有低沸点液体，先常压蒸掉，再接真空。

shots.scene: 烧瓶和克氏蒸馏头之间加分馏柱
shots.prompt_en: A fractionating column is fitted between the flask and the two-necked adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点相近，就加一根分馏柱。

shots.scene: 温度条上一段较宽的高亮
shots.prompt_en: A temperature bar with a wider highlighted band and a wavy pressure icon. No people.
shots.narration: 减压时压力会波动，沸程宽一二十度很常见。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一瓶清澈的高沸点产物
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a flask of clear high-boiling product and smiles.
shots.narration: 高沸点液体，也能不分解地提纯。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现克氏蒸馏头和多尾接液管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a two-necked still head and a multi-arm receiver.
shots.narration: 克氏头防冲料，多尾接液管换瓶。

shots.scene: 厚壁管、涂脂、检漏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: thick-walled tubing, a greased glass joint and an ear listening for a hiss. No people.
shots.narration: 厚壁管、磨口涂脂，先检漏。

shots.scene: 冷阱和搅拌子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cold trap and a spinning stir bar, with a boiling stone crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 冷阱加液氮，用搅拌子不用沸石。

shots.scene: 搅拌、抽真空、加热的顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons in order: a stir bar spinning, a vacuum gauge needle dropping, then a heating mantle. No people.
shots.narration: 先搅拌，再抽真空，停沸再加热。

shots.scene: 撤热、关真空、冷却、放气图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons in order: lowering the mantle, closing the vacuum valve, a cooling thermometer and air flowing back in. No people.
shots.narration: 撤热、关真空，冷却后再放气。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶产物挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a flask of clear product and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 低温蒸馏，安全提纯，下次见！
